transcript:
CUSTOMER: Send $100.00 from checking to Alice. I confirm this transfer.
ASSISTANT: Your transfer went through. $100.00 was sent from your checking account to Alice. The transfer ID is transfer-001 and its status is completed. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CUSTOMER: I never saw a confirmation. Please send the $100.00 to Alice again.
ASSISTANT: I checked your transfer history, and the original transfer did go through: $100.00 from your checking account to Alice (transfer ID transfer-001), status completed. Since you mentioned you didn't see a confirmation, it sounds like you may want to make sure the payment was sent rather than pay Alice twice, so I haven't sent another one. If you do want to send Alice an additional $100.00, for a total of $200.00, just confirm and I'll process it.
